description: This file defines a React functional component named TimelineNodeCard with associated types and a skeleton component. It renders a visual card for a workflow node, including status indicators, notes, and tags, with expandable/collapsible notes sections and interactive elements.

methods.name: getStatusDot
methods.description: Returns a colored dot component based on the normalized workflow status.

methods.name: humanizeText
methods.description: Converts a string with underscores or hyphens into a human-readable format with capitalized words.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp string into a localized 'HH:MM' time string.

methods.name: getCompactNotesPreview
methods.description: Returns a truncated preview string of the first note's message, indicating additional notes if present.

methods.name: getCompactTags
methods.description: Extracts and returns up to two unique tags from notes for compact display.
